status: Bounded pixel-history diagnostics only rewrite their JSON file when a new event is appended.
change: Remember event count before examining a completed GPU batch; preserve the exact output array and write only on an actual append. This avoids reserializing/writing a large unchanged diagnostic file on every later batch, including after the record limit.
validation: Node syntax check passed; event production, GPU completion and original drawing calls are unchanged. The live investigation switched to a bounded append-only host observer to release old diagnostic wrappers.
limits: Diagnostic-only storage/CPU change; no rendering semantics or original result claim.
